Hi Karim — thanks for sending these over and for the heads up. Quick notes so we can move forward: 

1) Evidence needed for TIN/name mismatch: our procurement/payments policy requires one of the following to clear a name/TIN mismatch:
   - IRS EIN assignment letter (CP575) OR
   - Bank letter (on bank letterhead) that lists the legal entity and EIN, OR
   - Recent form 940/941 with EIN redacted (if a bank letter/CP575 cannot be produced)

A payroll screenshot alone usually isn't sufficient for the payments team to clear the portal. If you can upload a bank letter or CP575 that will let us reconcile immediately.

2) Delegated signer: we can accept a delegated signer if you provide a company authorization letter (signed by an officer) that names the delegate, and the delegate signs via DocuSign. Please have the authorization letter attached and route the W-9 through DocuSign to ap@cloudrelay.com.

I'll loop in Laura (legal) and Monica (payments) to confirm there are no additional requirements for a PO hold release. If you can get the authorization letter and either the CP575 or bank letter uploaded, we'll proceed with a conditional PO creation.

Thanks — I can also start a provisional PO number for you and note "pending tax evidence" to speed the payments queue once evidence lands.

Best,
